verdict.rationale: Ente Auth's only own automation is backup. Its docs say Ente's CLI can automatically back up Auth codes, and the app has an automatic daily local backup, though that backup only runs "when you open the app" rather than autonomously in the background. There are no general user-configurable automations; recurring background scheduling would rely on the user's own scripting ("script a workflow"), which earns no credit. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined automations, true background or scheduled execution independent of app launch, and automation beyond backups.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: You can use [Ente's CLI](https://github.com/ente/ente/tree/main/cli#readme) to automatically backup your Auth codes.
Automatic daily backups: When enabled, Ente Auth creates one local backup per day when you open the app.
Open `Settings > Data > Local backup` to enable automatic local backups
